# Weebly
> Weebly is a website builder and ecommerce platform for creating websites, blogs, and online stores with customizable themes, domains, and built-in business tools.

Weebly helps individuals and businesses launch and grow online with site building, ecommerce features, design themes, apps, SEO resources, and support documentation.

## Core Product
- [Websites](https://www.weebly.com/websites): Overview of Weebly’s website builder for creating business sites, portfolios, and blogs.
- [Online Stores](https://www.weebly.com/online-store): Ecommerce product overview for building and managing an online store with Weebly.
- [Pricing](https://www.weebly.com/ca/pricing): Plans and pricing for websites and online stores, including feature comparisons.
- [Features](https://www.weebly.com/ca/features): Summary of key website builder features, tools, and business capabilities.
- [Sign Up](https://www.weebly.com/signup): Account creation page for starting a new Weebly website or store.
- [Log In](https://www.weebly.com/login): Login page for accessing the Weebly editor, dashboard, and account tools.

## Design and Customization
- [Themes](https://www.weebly.com/ca/themes): Theme gallery for selecting and previewing website templates and designs.
- [Websites](https://www.weebly.com/websites): Product page covering site creation, layout tools, and customization options.
- [Features](https://www.weebly.com/ca/features): Feature overview including design, editing, publishing, and business tools.
- [Sign Up](https://www.weebly.com/signup): Start building with a template and customize your site after signup.

## Ecommerce
- [Online Stores](https://www.weebly.com/online-store): Ecommerce landing page for selling products online with Weebly.
- [Pricing](https://www.weebly.com/ca/pricing): Compare plans for ecommerce features, payments, and store management tools.
- [Features](https://www.weebly.com/ca/features): Overview of store-related capabilities alongside website and growth features.
- [App Center](https://www.weebly.com/ca/app-center): Extensions and integrations that add store, marketing, and site functionality.

## Apps and Integrations
- [App Center](https://www.weebly.com/ca/app-center): Marketplace for apps and integrations that extend Weebly websites and stores.
- [Features](https://www.weebly.com/ca/features): Product capabilities page covering built-in tools and extensibility options.
- [Online Stores](https://www.weebly.com/online-store): Ecommerce overview with tools for selling, fulfillment, and store operations.

## SEO and Growth Resources
- [SEO Guide](https://www.weebly.com/seo): Search engine optimization resource for improving website visibility and traffic.
- [Features](https://www.weebly.com/ca/features): Growth-oriented features for websites, marketing, and online business management.
- [Websites](https://www.weebly.com/websites): Website builder overview for launching and expanding an online presence.
- [Online Stores](https://www.weebly.com/online-store): Store-building tools for growing ecommerce sales and customer reach.

## Support
- [Help Center](https://hc.weebly.com/hc/en-us): Official support center with help articles, troubleshooting, and account guidance.
- [Log In](https://www.weebly.com/login): Access your account to manage sites, settings, and support-related tasks.
- [Sign Up](https://www.weebly.com/signup): Create an account to begin using Weebly’s website and store tools.

## Learning and Content
- [SEO Guide](https://www.weebly.com/seo): Educational guide for SEO best practices and website optimization.

## Account and Onboarding
- [Sign Up](https://www.weebly.com/signup): Start a new Weebly account and begin building a website or store.
- [Log In](https://www.weebly.com/login): Sign in to edit sites, manage domains, and access account settings.
- [Pricing](https://www.weebly.com/ca/pricing): Review plan options before choosing a website or ecommerce subscription.
- [Themes](https://www.weebly.com/ca/themes): Browse templates before starting a new site build.
